# Mohd Kaif (kaifcoder)

> Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer based in Delhi, India. Creator of AdZero.
> Official Website: https://www.kaifcoder.in
> Verified Identity: Mohd Kaif, known online as kaifcoder, kaif coder, and @kaif_coder.

## About Mohd Kaif
Mohd Kaif is an Indian Full Stack Developer, Software Engineer, and AI Engineer based in Delhi, India. He builds high-performance, resilient web and mobile applications with modern cloud and agentic AI architectures. He is the author and creator of AdZero, a 100% ad-free private streaming and browsing utility for Android.
